description: This file defines data models for a restaurant application, including classes for menu categories, menu items, cart items, orders, and reviews. It contains data structures used for representing menu data, user orders, and reviews within the app.

classes.name: MenuCategory
classes.description: Represents a category of menu items with id, name, description, and image URL.

classes.name: MenuItemModel
classes.description: Represents a menu item with details such as id, category, name, description, ingredients, spice level, prices, images, allergens, and nutrition info.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an item added to a shopping cart, including the menu item, portion size, quantity, optional spice level, and add-ons.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a user order with id, list of cart items, status, creation timestamp, fulfillment method, and total price.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Represents a customer review with id, associated order id, rating, comment, optional photo URL, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: MenuCategory.fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a MenuCategory instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: MenuItemModel.fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a MenuItemModel instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: Review.fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a Review instance from a JSON map.
